# Crumb & Clock

> An upcoming mobile sourdough baking companion for home bakers. The app is in development; no release date or pricing has been announced. All app screens on this website are design previews.

Planned capabilities include starter feeding and observation records, flexible sourdough bake scheduling, guided active bakes, and a personal recipe and bake journal. Estimates are intended to support dough observations, not replace them.

## Practical sourdough guides

- [The Baker’s Journal](/journal): Practical home baking guidance.
- [How to plan sourdough around your day](/journal/sourdough-baking-schedule): Work backwards from serving time and distinguish hands-on work from waiting.
- [Is your sourdough starter ready to bake?](/journal/when-is-sourdough-starter-ready): Use repeated rise, bubbles, and comparable feeding observations.
- [How to tell when bulk fermentation is done](/journal/when-is-bulk-fermentation-done): Observe dough temperature, rise, bubbles, and texture together.
- [Privacy](/privacy): Early-access data practices and email removal form.
